title: Test Review
description: analysis/test-reviews/[story-id].test-review.json. Produced by the Test Reviewer Agent, an advisory AI review at Gate 4: it reads the generated test against the approved test cases and the reviewed spec, for how strongly each assertion checks the case's expected result and how faithfully the test follows the cases. It never approves or rejects, and has no field that could (CLAUDE.md §3.5). It names the Gate 4 input digest it reviewed (input_digest, printed by the runner's step instruction) and its round (1 to 3); the runner uses it only while that digest is current and the round is the one it expects. An empty findings list means the reviewer reported nothing, not that the test is right (docs/review-gates.md, "Advisory AI review").

input_digest.description: The Gate 4 (code_reviewed) input digest this review was made against, as the runner's step instruction printed it.

round.description: Which review of this gate in the run this is. After round 1, only what changed since the previous round is reviewed; there is no round 4.

findings.description: What the human should weigh at Gate 4. Each one is answered at the gate (fixed, wrong, intentional, irrelevant) before the decision.

type.description: weak_assertion: an assertion that would pass with the case's behavior broken (presence instead of value, a loose match, a count without content). missing_assertion: a step of the case whose expected result nothing asserts. expected_value_mismatch: an asserted value that is not the case's expected result. case_not_tested: an approved automate_e2e case with no test. behavior_not_in_cases: a test asserting behavior no approved case describes. traceability_gap: a test that does not name its TC-XXX or SPEC-XXX.

tc_id.description: Optional. The case the finding concerns.

line.description: Optional. The line of the generated test the finding concerns.

quote.description: Optional. The test code the finding is about, quoted.

severity.description: How strongly this should weigh on the Gate 4 decision.

recommendations.description: Short suggestions for the human or the Generator (e.g. 'assert the total equals $49.30, not that it is visible').
